```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(uwot)

set.seed(1)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r read_data}
data_all <- fread(
  "expression_matrix.csv",
  sep = "\t",
  data.table = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

if (file.exists("expressed_mirnas.txt")) {
  data_name_filter <- fread(
    "expressed_mirnas.txt",
    header = FALSE,
    data.table = FALSE
  )
  data_filter <- data_all[which(data_all$miRNA %in% data_name_filter[, 1]), ]
} else {
  data_filter <- data_all
}

clinical_jama <- read_excel("eTable1.xlsx")
```

```{r align_samples}
## rename eTable1 columns to simple names
colnames(clinical_jama) <- c(
  "sample_number", "age", "gender", "smoking_history",
  "pack_years", "disease", "group", "stage"
)

## expression matrix: first col = miRNA, remaining cols = samples
feature_id <- data_filter[[1]]
expr_df <- data_filter[, -1, drop = FALSE]

## force numeric conversion column by column
expr_df[] <- lapply(expr_df, function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)))

expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr_df)
rownames(expr_mat) <- feature_id
storage.mode(expr_mat) <- "numeric"

## remove bad rows first
keep_feature <- apply(expr_mat, 1, function(v) all(is.finite(v)))
expr_mat <- expr_mat[keep_feature, , drop = FALSE]

## log exactly as in jama_scenario_pretest.Rmd
expr_mat <- log2(expr_mat + 1)

expr_colnames <- colnames(data_filter)[-1]

## build within-group labels exactly as jama_scenario_pretest.Rmd
meta <- clinical_jama %>%
  mutate(
    group = as.character(group),
    stage = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(stage))
  ) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(within_group_id = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    expr_label = case_when(
      group == "HC"   ~ paste0("Healthy control ", within_group_id),
      group == "NTLD" ~ paste0("NTLD ", within_group_id),
      group == "LCa"  ~ paste0("LCa ", within_group_id),
      group == "OD"   ~ paste0("OD ", within_group_id),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

meta_aligned <- meta[match(expr_colnames, meta$expr_label), ]

stopifnot(ncol(expr_mat) == nrow(meta_aligned))
stopifnot(all(expr_colnames == meta_aligned$expr_label))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(meta_aligned$sample_number)))

cat("Aligned sample count:", ncol(expr_mat), "\n")
print(table(meta_aligned$group))

```

```{r build_scenarios}
build_scenario_data <- function(expr_mat, meta_aligned,
                                scenario = c("scenario1", "scenario2", "scenario3")) {
  scenario <- match.arg(scenario)

  if (scenario == "scenario1") {
    keep <- meta_aligned$group %in% c("LCa", "NTLD", "OD", "HC")
    y <- ifelse(meta_aligned$group[keep] == "LCa", "LCa", "non_LCa")
  }

  if (scenario == "scenario2") {
    keep <- meta_aligned$group %in% c("LCa", "NTLD")
    y <- ifelse(meta_aligned$group[keep] == "LCa", "LCa", "NTLD")
  }

  if (scenario == "scenario3") {
    keep <- (meta_aligned$group == "LCa" & meta_aligned$stage %in% c(1, 2)) |
            (meta_aligned$group %in% c("NTLD", "OD", "HC"))
    y <- ifelse(meta_aligned$group[keep] == "LCa" & meta_aligned$stage[keep] %in% c(1, 2),
                "early_LCa", "non_lung_cancer")
  }

  list(
    x = expr_mat[, keep, drop = FALSE],
    meta = meta_aligned[keep, , drop = FALSE],
    y = factor(y)
  )
}

## change only here when you want another scenario
scenario_name <- "scenario1"
sc <- build_scenario_data(expr_mat, meta_aligned, scenario_name)

print(table(sc$y))
print(table(sc$meta$group, useNA = "ifany"))

```

```{r feature_filtering}
# Figure 1.1
data1 <- as.data.frame(sc$x)
rownames(data1) <- rownames(sc$x)

means <- apply(data1, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
names(means) <- rownames(data1)
sds <- apply(data1, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
names(sds) <- rownames(data1)

poordata <- data1[which(means < 6.2 & means > 3.5), , drop = FALSE]
positive_data <- data1[which(means > 6.5), , drop = FALSE]

poordata <- poordata[rowSums(is.na(poordata)) == 0, , drop = FALSE]
positive_data <- positive_data[rowSums(is.na(positive_data)) == 0, , drop = FALSE]

hist(means, breaks = 200)
abline(v = 3.5, col = "blue")
abline(v = 6.2, col = "blue")
abline(v = 6.5, col = "red")

plot(x = means, y = sds)
abline(v = 3.5, col = "blue")
abline(v = 6.2, col = "blue")
abline(v = 6.5, col = "red")

print(dim(poordata))
print(dim(positive_data))
print(sum(is.na(poordata)))
print(sum(is.na(positive_data)))

```

```{r umap_and_batch}
# Figure 1.2
set.seed(1)

uhdata_averaged.umap <- uwot::umap(t(poordata), n_components = 4)
layout <- as.data.frame(uhdata_averaged.umap)
colnames(layout)[1:4] <- c("X1", "X2", "X3", "X4")

layout_df <- layout %>%
  mutate(
    UMAP1 = -X1,
    UMAP2 = -X2,
    class_label = sc$y,
    group = sc$meta$group,
    sample_number = sc$meta$sample_number,
    expr_label = sc$meta$expr_label
  )

layout_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = class_label)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(title = paste0("UMAP - ", scenario_name),
       y = "UMAP2", x = "UMAP1")

## keep the original simple UMAP-cutting idea, only minimal change
#layout_df <- layout_df %>%
  #mutate(batch = ifelse(UMAP1 < 0.4, 1, 2))
layout_df <- layout_df %>%
  mutate(batch = ifelse(UMAP2 < 2.5, 1, 2))

batch_id <- layout_df$batch

print(table(batch_id))
print(table(layout_df$class_label, batch_id))
print(table(layout_df$group, batch_id))

```

```{r plot_batch}
p_batch_new <- layout_df %>%
  mutate(batch = factor(batch, levels = c(1, 2))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11)) +
  labs(title = paste0("UMAP with 2 inferred batches - ", scenario_name),
       x = "UMAP1",
       y = "UMAP2",
       color = "Batch") +
  #geom_vline(xintercept = 0.4, linetype = 2)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2.5, linetype = 2)

p_batch_new

```

```{r}
stopifnot(nrow(sc$meta) == ncol(positive_data))
stopifnot(length(batch_id) == ncol(positive_data))
stopifnot(all(colnames(positive_data) == sc$meta$expr_label))

## 1) data: force matrix
positive_mat <- as.matrix(positive_data)
storage.mode(positive_mat) <- "numeric"

## 2) class: use scenario-defined y, not old LCa-vs-all hardcode
class_vec <- sc$y
class_vec <- droplevels(class_vec)

## 3) batch: atomic vector
batch_vec <- as.numeric(batch_id)

## 4) final alignment checks
stopifnot(ncol(positive_mat) == length(class_vec))
stopifnot(ncol(positive_mat) == length(batch_vec))
stopifnot(all(colnames(positive_mat) == sc$meta$expr_label))

str(positive_mat)
str(class_vec)
str(batch_vec)

print(table(class_vec, useNA = "ifany"))
print(table(batch_vec, useNA = "ifany"))
print(table(class_vec, batch_vec, useNA = "ifany"))
```

```{r}
start_time <- Sys.time()

times <- 3
ml_sum(
  n = times,
  data = positive_mat,
  class = class_vec,
  batch = batch_vec,
  batch_time = FALSE,
  early_batch_id = 2,
  batch_balance = TRUE,
  ml = c("knn", "lasso", "svm", "pam", "xgb","rf"),
  split_combination = c(50,70,80,90,100),
  data_type_rnaseq = FALSE,
  file = paste0("jama_", scenario_name)
)

end_time <- Sys.time()
run_time <- end_time - start_time
print(run_time)
```
